title: RemediationPolicy
description: The tenant's remediation policy (triage policy in the console): the remediation window per severity band, the triage threshold, and the CVSS scores that separate the bands. Exposure reports grade against it, compliance reports cite it, and jail COUNT_PAST_SLA rules read its windows. One per tenant. Either adopt a published standard as it is, so reports cite the standard, or declare your own windows. Saving your own never edits the policy earlier snapshots and reports cite: it saves a new revision and points the tenant at it.

standard.description: A published standard, adopted as it is: baseline-cvss (Baseline CVSS), nist-800-40 (NIST SP 800-40), fedramp (FedRAMP), essential8 (Essential 8), cisa-bod-19-02 (CISA BOD 19-02).

remediationDays.description: Days to remediate a finding in each band. Windows that do not widen as severity falls are accepted with a warning: they are usually transposed.

allowanceDays.description: Grace days past each band's window before a finding counts as past its SLA.

triageThresholdDays.description: Days by which a new finding must be triaged. Longer than the critical window is accepted with a warning.

suppressionReviewMaxAgeDays.description: How long a suppression may go without being re-affirmed before reports call it overdue.

severityThresholds.description: The CVSS base scores that separate the severity bands, as the published standards define them. They must increase: low < medium < high.
